description: Job listings from The Muse public API (US and remote companies): title, company, locations, level, category, posted date, link. The API has no salary field. Returns one page of up to 20 jobs per call. Choose this tool for: Job listings from The Muse public API: title, company. Close alternatives on this server: jobs_ashby_jobs_board (Open roles from one company's public Ashby job board); jobs_greenhouse_jobs (Open roles from one company's public Greenhouse job board). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

page.description: Result page, 1 to 50 (default 1; 20 jobs per page)
